name: local-ssh-deploy
description: Save reusable encrypted SSH server connections for remote commands, maintenance, file workflows, and project deployment.

interface.shortDescription: Save SSH connections for reusable remote server tasks.
interface.longDescription: Opens a local connection editor with a native private-key path picker and saves named SSH connection profiles in the current user's OS credential protection. Reuse a profile for remote commands, maintenance, file workflows, or project deployment; task-specific directories and commands are supplied at execution time and never stored in the profile. Private key contents are never accepted, read, or uploaded.
defaultPrompt: Add a remote server connection and open its secure editor.
Check disk usage on my saved production server.
List my saved SSH server connections.
